facts.big: there is/are · a lot of · a little · a few
facts.label: Cardápio e quantidades
facts.sub: Use there is/are e quantificadores para falar de comida: There is a lot of cheese. There are a few salads. Pergunte How much…? e How many…?

facts.label: Há
facts.sub: Use there is com uma coisa ou com algo que não se conta: There is tomato soup. Use there are com várias coisas: There are a few salads. Pergunte Is there any soup? e Are there any salads?

facts.label: Muito
facts.sub: Use many com coisas que se contam: many salads, many chips. Use much com coisas que não se contam: much meat, much cheese. A pergunta é How much cheese? e How many salads?

items.s: We use many with things we can count.

pages.title: A small diner · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Tuesday at noon in a small diner in London. The windows are warm with steam. Abby writes the menu on a board. Her friend Marco sits at the counter. He is hungry after work. He asks about the food.
“Hi, Marco! Here is today’s menu.” says Abby. “Thanks. Is there any soup today?” says Marco. “Yes, there is tomato soup. There are also a few salads.” says Abby.
